short.zh: 承接《极简输入》：现场副驾学习组织节拍与控制，进入 DJ 现场模拟；舞台复刻学习解构与重组场景，用四种状态完成网页预演和分享。
short.en: Extending Minimal Input: Live Show Copilot organizes rhythm and controls for a live DJ simulation; Stage Replica deconstructs and remixes a scene into four states for browser preview and sharing.

premise.zh: 科目一“我能演了”，科目二“我能搭了”。从真实工程与喜欢的现场开始，AI / MCP 辅助整理控制与空间。
premise.en: Learn to perform and build a stage, starting from a real show project and scenes you love. AI / MCP assists with control and spatial organization.
